driver.config:
dm_gripper_motor_node:
  ros__parameters:
    # SocketCAN interfaces and DM motor IDs.
    left_can_interface: "vcan0"
    right_can_interface: "vcan1"
    left_motor_id: 1
    right_motor_id: 2

    # Each control cycle sends both MIT commands and drains received CAN frames.
    control_rate_hz: 1000.0
    # Publishes the latest decoded feedback to ROS topics; this is not CAN RX frequency.
    feedback_rate_hz: 200.0
    rx_frames_per_cycle: 32

    # MIT command: [position, velocity, kp, kd, torque].
    # Position is generated at runtime from /tj/control/gripperValueL/R and the limits below.
    vel_cmd: 0.0
    kp: 3.0
    kd: 0.12
    current_limit: 0.0

    Motor1_min_pos: 0.0
    Motor1_max_pos: 1.6
    Motor2_min_pos: 0.0
    Motor2_max_pos: 1.6

    auto_calibrate: false
    disable_on_shutdown: false
